hero.title: Bama Cheer Xtreme
hero.subtitle: Competitive all-star cheer for athletes who chase the routine until it's perfect.

about.heading: Built on the mat, not the sideline
about.body: Bama Cheer Xtreme trains competitive all-star athletes from Tiny tots through Senior level. Our coaches come from collegiate and all-star competition backgrounds, and our program is built around technique, safety, and teamwork — not just tumbling passes.

programs.name: All-Star Teams
programs.description: Levels 1–6, tryouts each spring. Full competition season with regional and national events.

programs.name: Tumbling Classes
programs.description: Beginner through advanced tumbling instruction, open to athletes outside our competitive teams.

programs.name: Tiny Tots
programs.description: Ages 4–6. First steps in cheer fundamentals — motions, jumps, and confidence on the mat.

programs.name: Private Coaching
programs.description: One-on-one sessions for skill-specific goals: standing tucks, running passes, stunting technique.

contact.hours: Hours coming soon — call or email to confirm practice times
